owner: Duane reviews and merges this gate. Engineering removes an entry when the advisory is actually fixed.

policy.fullReport: CI prints the full audit report, including dev and build-tool findings, without making non-critical transitive findings block every pull request.
policy.rationale: Expo SDK 57 compatibility checks pass. Safe same-line overrides fix the current body-parser, qs and undici advisories. Remaining findings require Expo SDK 58, an incompatible Expo downgrade, or an unverified major transitive override.

residualAdvisories.reason: npm offers expo-router 58 as the fix, which is beyond the approved Expo SDK 57 scope. An isolated major override is not verified against query-string's CommonJS loading path.
residualAdvisories.followUp: Resolve with the approved Expo SDK 58 upgrade or an Expo Router 57 patch that removes the vulnerable chain.
